culprit_citations.quoted_text: Header: Reference Rate Spread / Floor | Cash Interest Rate / PIK Rate; row: W.A. Kendall and Company, LLC Revolving Loan | 3M SOFR + 7.25 % / 1.00 % | 12.13 % | 4/22/2030

rationale: Class 2 within-row rate extraction issue. The raw SOI row distinguishes Reference Rate Spread / Floor from Cash Interest Rate / PIK Rate. For the cited W.A. Kendall Revolving Loan, the source shows reference spread/floor of 3M SOFR + 7.25% / 1.00% and a stated cash interest/coupon rate of 12.13%. The bundle row shows the stored interest_rate pattern retained 7.25 rather than the all-in stated coupon, causing pik_le_interest_rate to fire. Under the rule-specific all-in convention, storing the reference spread instead of the stated all-in coupon is a real extraction error.
